topic: Adult-onset Stills disease AOSD: quotidian fever, salmon rash, ferritin, IL-1 inhibition

source.title: Mechanisms, biomarkers and targets for adult-onset Still's disease
source.whyItFits: Open review of adult-onset Still's disease covering fever, the salmon-pink rash, Yamaguchi criteria, innate cytokines including IL-1, and anakinra. A stored file titled as an AOSD review contained no Still's-disease text and was rejected.

notes: The in-app file titled Adult-Onset Still's Disease contained inflammasome text and the words Still, AOSD, and adult-onset did not appear. It was rejected.
